beats.text: As ICE Out protests spread across Minnesota against expanded ICE raids, NPR reported thousands marching downtown in subzero cold. Trump had a different theory.

beats.caption: they're they're paid agitators and insurrectionists.
beats.label: via Fox News

beats.text: Bold theory for a day when, per GPB, hundreds of Minnesota businesses closed just to let their staff march.

beats.caption: These are professional agitators and professional people
beats.label: via Fox News

beats.text: He'd said it two days earlier too, in the same Truth Social breath as insurrectionists and anarchists.

beats.caption: met with paid agitators and insurrectionists, troublemakers.
beats.label: via Fox News

beats.text: PolitiFact checked, found no evidence of organized payment, and rated the claim false. Turns out subzero Minnesotans just really hate ICE raids.
